intent: Preserve the approved V7 height, footprint and clearance while adding readable fairground micro-detail to the ship and loading platform.

resolutionContract.note: The attraction must remain clean and readable when exported above 1000 px. Micro-details must be authored as real geometry/material detail, not painted only for a 512 px proxy.

optional2DPolish.purpose: Apply only small deterministic raster/paint overlays after the 1280px Blender master is visually reviewed. Use for edge cleanup, color separation, small highlights, rivet/light accents and minor platform/boat paint corrections; never use it to change perspective, footprint, support height, swing clearance or rebuild missing 3D structure.
optional2DPolish.inputPolicy: Always retain the untouched Blender RGBA master and generate a separate 2D-polished candidate.
